desc.p: Deletes draft logs (field notes) of the user, as the website's own field notes page does. Only the user's own drafts can be deleted. Draft IDs are returned by services/draftlogs/query and by services/draftlogs/upload_fieldnotes.
This method is only available on installations that support draft logs. Check the has_draft_logs field in services/apisrv/installation before calling it.

req.name: draft_ids
req.p: Pipe-separated list of draft IDs, at most 500.

returns.p: A dictionary of the following structure:

ul.li: deleted_draft_ids - list of the IDs that were deleted,
not_found_draft_ids - list of the IDs that were not deleted, because no such draft exists or it belongs to another user.
